fix.patch:
diff --git a/Chummer/app.config b/Chummer/app.config
index cb5f072..5bb6b3d 100644
--- a/Chummer/app.config
+++ b/Chummer/app.config
@@ -1,4 +1,8 @@
 <?xml version="1.0"?>
 <configuration>
 <startup><supportedRuntime version="v4.0" sku=".NETFramework,Version=v4.8.1"/></startup>
+<runtime>
+<!-- Keep the Windows Forms accessibility behaviour of .NET Framework 4.0, which the app was made for; the newer behaviour that targeting 4.8.1 turns on changes how the app looks, for example focus rectangles on tabs. -->
+<AppContextSwitchOverrides value="Switch.UseLegacyAccessibilityFeatures=true;Switch.UseLegacyAccessibilityFeatures.2=true;Switch.UseLegacyAccessibilityFeatures.3=true;Switch.UseLegacyAccessibilityFeatures.4=true;Switch.UseLegacyAccessibilityFeatures.5=true"/>
+</runtime>
 </configuration>

added: <!-- Keep the Windows Forms accessibility behaviour of .NET Framework 4.0, which the app was made for; the newer behaviour that targeting 4.8.1 turns on changes how the app looks, for example focus rectangles on tabs. -->
